log.text: Focus model chosen: root.focus is an ID on the root Panel instance (where root.templates already rides), never serialized. Clicking a panel's own bar or body takes it — `e.target.closest('.panel-bar, .panel-body').parentElement === $panel.el`, which makes the innermost panel win with nobody stopping an event and excludes GRIPS (pointer capture retargets the click at the end of a resize, so a seam drag was focusing the split).

action.text: Focus plumbing: exported focused()/vocab()/repaint(), added inspects() + focus(), the .focus class in view(), the click handler, a views WeakMap of {$panel,$body,$items} per item, and a remove listener clearing dead focus in a microtask (move() is remove-then-insert).

NEW, 75 lines. The inspector: focused panel's words as chips, each one item.set() + repaint(). Two root listeners (focus, change) that unbind themselves when their element is no longer in a workspace.

log.text: Two measured CSS findings: (1) .panel-body centres what it is handed and centred overflow spills out of BOTH ends — the inspector's first row sat 75px above its own panel, unreachable by scrolling; fixed locally with align-content:start, and `safe center` on .panel-body would fix every overflowing template at once. (2) The bar is an overlay that lights on hover, i.e. exactly when a control surface's top row is in use — 2.4em reserved, 28.4px measured against 12.4px text.

Verified on /framework/ext/Panel/ and /full/ with playwright: focus follows clicks (one ring at a time), inspector edits repaint the target live and persist (panels.json gained template/tone/align/mode from the inspector's own writes), TWO inspectors track the same panel, closing the focused panel falls back to the empty state, grip drag / panel drag / layout roll all still work, dark mode clean, ZERO console errors. panels.json diff-restored byte-identical to the backup — no `focus` key ever appeared.

Two hazards found and closed: hug on a SPLIT collapses it to 0px (children size from a parent sizing from them) — the inspector withholds `mode` from splits, exactly as the bar does; and the focus ring is guarded by `.panel-workspace:has(.panel-props)` so a workspace with no inspector shows no mark and ext/editor's five regions are visually untouched. Pre-existing and NOT fixed: the grip's hug/fill menu can still hug a split.
